# BDH state microscope

Independent educational artifact, no Pathway endorsement. Final-push v2 is preview-only pending approval; the stable production URL still serves the submitted version.

## Artifacts

- [Guided microscope](https://bdh-state-microscope-review-drcocktails-projects.vercel.app/): compare direct causal linear attention with an accumulated memory matrix, then vary key overlap. In the one-hot-value fixture, identity-frame margin is 1 - m c; RoPE correction is computed.
- [Lab](https://bdh-state-microscope-review-drcocktails-projects.vercel.app/lab/): seeded synthetic experiments, not trained-model evaluation.
- [Observability essay](https://bdh-state-microscope-review-drcocktails-projects.vercel.app/blog/): a concrete rule-graph example explains how missing information and insufficient computation can be distinguished, and when observations are ambiguous.
- [Detailed source records](https://bdh-state-microscope-review-drcocktails-projects.vercel.app/blog/claims.json): evidence types, limitations and primary-source locators, outside the main reading flow.
- [Source](https://github.com/drcocktail/bdh-state-microscope/tree/final-push): code, reproducibility and disclosure.

## Evidence policy

Source records distinguish calculated examples, recorded replays and published results. The user-authorized copy revision removes category badges from the main reading flow; methods and citations retain the distinctions. Never describe the toy as trained BDH, a reproduction of BDH-CQ, an endorsed product, or a full-model architectural improvement. Capacity depends on corpus/seed/classes/calibration; tensor accounting is not measured runtime savings. Claims of proprietary internal mechanism are not supported.
